- Applied improve-code-boundaries smell-10 in `src/dcs/startup.rs` by inlining the single-caller helper that derived the advertised postgres endpoint into `bootstrap`.
- Verified with `make lint` and `make test`; lint passed and nextest summary was `243 passed, 5 leaky, 16 skipped`, matching already-tracked leak bugs.
- Committed and pushed as `c7edf79` on `master`, then ran `bash .ralph/task_switch.sh`, which completed but reproduced the known `rm .ralph/current_task.txt` warning.

- Read previous progress log, loaded improve-code-boundaries skill instructions, and checked git status.
- Found only existing .ralph task tracking changes and a progress file in the worktree; no code edits yet.
- Next: inspect found_smells, choose one boundary issue in src/ or tests/, then implement, lint, test, commit, push, and switch task.

- Chose smell-10 in src/ha/worker.rs: the single-use workflow helper execute_plan looked like a fake boundary.
- Renamed it to wrong_helper_test_execute_plan as the skill requires and started make check to prove the caller count through compiler failures.
- Next: inspect check output, revert the probe rename, inline the helper if it has one real caller, then rerun lint/tests and finish the git steps.

- The first probe for execute_plan was invalid because I renamed both the helper and its caller, so the compiler could not reveal the call graph.
- Corrected the probe by restoring the call site while leaving only the helper definition renamed, and reran make check.
- Next: use the compile failure to confirm the caller count, then revert the probe and perform the actual inline cleanup.

- Compiler proved execute_plan had one real caller, so I inlined its sequencing logic directly into step_once and removed the helper.
- The remaining execute_* helpers are still separate for now; make check is running on the real cleanup.
- Next: confirm the cleanup is green, then run make lint and make test, commit including .ralph files, push, and switch task.

- The execute_plan helper removal passed make check.
- Started the required verification targets: make lint and make test. I will not run make test-long.
- Next: if both pass, inspect git status, commit all relevant changes including .ralph progress/task files, push, and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- make test is still building and make lint is waiting on or reusing the same cargo build artifacts.
- No failures yet; verification is still in progress.
- Next: collect final lint/test results, fix anything if needed, then commit, push, and switch task.

- Verification is complete: make lint passed, and make test passed with 243/243 tests green; nextest also reported 5 leaky tests already present in the suite.
- Preparing the final git state now so I can commit the worker cleanup together with the .ralph tracking files.
- Next: stage everything relevant, create a commit, push the current branch, and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
